value.strategy: to seek to generate returns through selective investment in a global portfolio of catastrophe bonds (“CatBonds”).
value.philosophy: Investors receive a risk premium in the form of a yield in exchange for bearing the risk of losses from pre-defined natural and non-natural catastrophic events.
value.asset_types: global portfolio of catastrophe bonds (“CatBonds”). CatBonds are debt securities that transfer the risk of catastrophic events from insurance companies, reinsurance companies, corporations, governments, etc. to the capital markets. Events include earthquakes or windstorms, mortality, cyber and catastrophe related events.
value.real_objectives: to seek to generate returns by receiving a risk premium in the form of a yield for bearing the risk of losses from pre-defined natural and non-natural catastrophic events.
